reply.summary: Ticor is a blue-and-violet cosmic peacekeeper from a world where names are birth-order numbers. Ticor patrols a far stretch of space with a ring-forged arsenal and a stubborn will, and calculates every fight like a proof.

feats.scene: Hurls a lattice of hard light that flattens a stack of derelict freighters in one pulse.
Stands inside a self-made shell while a collapsing relay station rains wreckage on it.

reply.summary: Tatil is a pale, yellow-eyed ring bearer who trained alongside two close friends and was mentored through grief by an older officer. Tatil excels at arithmetic and builds shields and beams from willpower.

feats.scene: Fires a focused column of green-white light that bores through an asteroid shell.
Weathers a barrage of beam fire behind a layered barrier without a scratch.

reply.summary: Rumam is a disembodied pair of legs that serves a cult of nothingness. Rumam smells so foul that anyone drawing near goes limp, and wanders battlefields offering no argument beyond the reek.

feats.scene: Stomps a parked van flat with a single kick.
Shrugs off a volley of thrown debris while still marching forward.

reply.summary: Nasttir is a pair of oversized evil legs hired to harass a team of teenage heroes. Nasttir only ever finishes half of any scheme, so every crime ends in a tidy, embarrassing draw.

feats.scene: Kicks half a billboard off its frame before getting bored.
Walks through a shower of cartoon explosions with only half a scorch mark.

reply.summary: Ntirata is a pierced, scarred and heavily mechanised brawler who rejected any call to reform. Ntirata fought for a rebellious prison population and died in a blast meant to end them all.

feats.scene: Rams a steel gate off its hinges with a cybernetic shoulder.
Walks out of a collapsing guard tower with only bent plating.

reply.summary: Neore is a chatty digital assistant living in a distant enduring metropolis and its networks. Neore fetches records, opens doors and guides a human investigator through the world of living data.

feats.scene: Overloads a door actuator to burst a lock open.
Survives a power surge by hopping between three backup servers.

reply.summary: Ntiunma is a violet-skinned woman from a harsh sister world who left a life of hired companionship to join a band of rebels. Ntiunma risked everything for love and died fighting a distant empire.

feats.scene: Fells three guards with a flurry of blows in a smoky corridor.
Takes a rifle butt to the ribs and keeps running.

reply.summary: Rnsernum is a violet-skinned, white-haired aristocrat who bridged the throne, the soldiers and the priesthood. Rnsernum stayed fiercely loyal to the ruler until captured by a rebel leader.

feats.scene: Hurls a heavy ceremonial staff across a throne room.
Endures a long march in chains without collapsing.

reply.summary: Reanu is a pale shapeshifting invader with orange eyes who hunted a family of volcano-born heroes. Reanu fears flame above all else and met a violent end in the pursuit.

feats.scene: Rips a bus in half and flings both pieces over a rooftop.
Takes a full-speed collision from a truck and rises again.

reply.summary: Eomisia is a pale, orange-eyed alien consort who served her husband's vendetta against a line of fiery heroes. Eomisia struck down their champion and paid for it with a fatal wound.

feats.scene: Drives a clawed hand through a stone altar to reach her target.
Stays standing after a crushing blow from a collapsing pillar.

reply.summary: Lloan is a red-eyed, bone-white invader who posed as a benevolent guest while softening a planet for conquest. Lloan reshaped deserts and executed prisoners as a show of friendship.

feats.scene: Snatches two guided missiles mid-air and hurls them back at their jet.
Plows through a frozen citadel wall and shakes off the ice.

reply.summary: Valstoll is a cruel, careless sprinter in a team of corporate-sponsored heroes. Valstoll flings foes toward bystanders without a thought and bolts before facing the consequences.

feats.scene: Crosses a freeway interchange before the nearest car horn finishes blaring.
Slams into a rogue android at full tilt and caves in its chest.
Skids across asphalt at top speed and stands up unhurt.

reply.summary: Seileeo is a titanium-plated war robot for hire with a taste for video games and a need to prove supremacy. Seileeo challenges heroes to duels and takes bruising seriously.

feats.scene: Punches through a vault door and bends the frame behind it.
Stands in the middle of a demolished garage with only a dented plate.

reply.summary: Ernurn is a grey, hairless stone-world native and a gentle moralist with a power ring. Ernurn keeps teammates honest and questions rash leaders, even when outvoted by a rival.

feats.scene: Sculpts a boulder of glowing energy and drops it on a mining platform.
Sits unharmed in a collapsing cavern, held by a rock-hard body and a ring field.

reply.summary: Corcorres is a grey, multi-armed chieftain of a warrior tribe from a battle-scarred land. Corcorres leads with strength and earns trust from outsiders through loyalty.

feats.scene: Brings four fists down at once and splits a siege ram.
Stands firm against a stampede of armoured beasts.

reply.summary: Levasiu is a brown-haired hunter-warrior from an ancient people that lived on the world long before its shining rulers. Levasiu fought back when a mad champion declared war on his kin.

feats.scene: Drives a flint spear through a raider's shield.
Fights on through a gash across the shoulder.

reply.summary: Tesiulle is a veteran security guard and family man who lost a hand to a reptilian prisoner. Tesiulle faced that fear by taking charge of the prisoner's guard detail and later shielded volunteer doctors inside a lawless zone.

feats.scene: Swings a steel baton into a rioter's arm.
Hauls a wounded doctor out of a burning ward.

reply.summary: Lisstnt is a patient whose experimental radiation cure left a tumour that drives him into explosive violence. Lisstnt was caged, then released to hunt for a rare plant that might shrink the growth.

feats.scene: Tears the bars off a cage and tosses them across a clinic.
Shrugs off a hail of bullets with only a snarl.

reply.summary: Aunliria is a bald, hulking misfit who rose in the chaos after a vampire hero fell. Aunliria prowled a dark city until the hero returned and ended the rampage.

feats.scene: Hurls a rusted car into a barricade of crates.
Staggers up from a fall through a warehouse roof.

reply.summary: Colli is a bald asylum inmate who killed his family with bare hands. Colli was manipulated into joining a murder spree designed to spread panic through the city.

feats.scene: Slams a detective into a wall hard enough to crack the plaster.
Walks off a blow from a police truncheon.

reply.summary: Nueor is a bald city police officer serving on a special crimes squad. Nueor died in the line of duty at the claws of a gigantic insect-themed criminal.

feats.scene: Tackles a fleeing gunman onto the hood of a cruiser.
Stays on his feet after a bruising fight on a rooftop.

reply.summary: Amiunte is an aspiring musician and the envious eldest brother in a family dominated by a stern father. Amiunte sings to be noticed and stews over a sibling's success.

feats.scene: Slams a fist on a kitchen table during a family argument.
Sings through a hostile crowd without losing the beat.

reply.summary: Nanser is a blue, genderless being cultivated in a tin vessel by soldier-scientists. Nanser is neither living nor dead, and answers to no easy word, drifting across desert roads as a quiet ally.

feats.scene: Raises a wave of dust that flings three trucks aside.
Stands upright in the center of a collapsing bunker.

reply.summary: Varleoamo is a casino boss, debt collector and racketeer who kidnapped a gambler to find a hidden island of warrior women. Varleoamo and his men never even reached the beach.

feats.scene: Fires a revolver at a ship's rail to scare the captain.
Takes a rope-whip across the face and keeps shouting orders.

reply.summary: Iusianu is a pit-dwelling demon who trades in souls and bargains for power. Iusianu once armed a mortal with a dark staff and later challenged a hero for a stolen soul.

feats.scene: Bursts out a column of hellfire that gutters a hilltop chapel.
Stands in the heart of a furnace and smiles.

reply.summary: Riarense is a blind, fallen winged guardian who circled the mouth of a vast infernal abyss for two thousand years. Riarense later joined a demon prince's army and helped level a fortress with combined fire.

feats.scene: Unleashes a storm of black flame that razes a hilltop fortress to slag.
Hangs in a hail of infernal blasts without losing altitude.

reply.summary: Iaror is a teenage shoeshine boy who got rich through a bank error and a shrewd turn on the market. Iaror kept a cool million and joined a group of wealthy youths.

feats.scene: Flings a polishing brush at a runaway pigeon.
Rides out a long day on the street corner without a break.

reply.summary: Eolast is a gentle caretaker and storyteller who keeps a haunted house in a realm of dreams, perpetually the victim of a brother's creative murders. Eolast always comes back and hosts guests with warm tales of betrayal.

feats.scene: Slams a door shut on a ghostly draught.
Is felled by a collapsing roof, then wakes up in his chair unharmed.

reply.summary: Miltiu is the first ever murder victim, now an immortal keeper of a house of tales and an elder among everlasting beings. Miltiu is timid and fragile in mind but cannot truly die.

feats.scene: Shoves a heavy bookcase against a creaking door.
Is dropped from a tower and gets back up in a fresh coat.

reply.summary: Tesau is a married woman from a southern African country and a childhood friend of a returning heroine. Tesau welcomed her old friend home as trouble began brewing.

feats.scene: Hugs her old friend at the village gate.
Walks the dusty road all afternoon in the heat.

reply.summary: Valcena is a white-and-black haired shopkeeper who ran a general store in a small desert town. Valcena was swept up with her neighbours when a cosmic visitor passed judgement on the whole community.

feats.scene: Lifts a crate of tinned peaches onto the counter.
Works a double shift through a dust storm.

reply.summary: Asian is a quiet friend of a swamp-bound plant creature, remembered mostly through a keepsake hair accessory. Asian matters to him far more than the player ever learns.

feats.scene: Tosses a pebble across a still pond.
Waits patiently through a long and muddy evening.

reply.summary: Niuteltia is a masked vigilante grandmother in a homemade costume, remembered through an old poster treasured by her granddaughter. Niuteltia proved that courage matters more than a pedigree.

feats.scene: Knocks a mugger flat with a cast-iron skillet.
Shrugs off a shove from a burly thug and swings back.

reply.summary: Numca is a tall, brown-haired housewife who donned a cooking-pot mask and became a masked crimefighter, later minding a hero team's headquarters. Numca earned the respect of the veterans with bravery.

feats.scene: Wades into an alley brawl and flings a thief into a dumpster.
Takes a club to the shoulder and laughs it off.

reply.summary: Stireosiu is a purple-skinned, brown-eyed interstellar guardian armed with a ring that makes solid light. Stireosiu serves with an unbreakable will and flies the lanes between star systems.

feats.scene: Casts a beam of green radiance that vaporises a drifting ice moon fragment.
Holds a shell of energy against a shattering comet impact.

reply.summary: Innusan is a pink-skinned, yellow-eyed protector with a fearsome devilish look who works in secret to avoid frightening locals. Innusan joined an alliance of heroes across many realities.

feats.scene: Fires a ring blast that cuts a hovering warship cleanly in two.
Endures a volley of cosmic fire inside a glowing sphere.

reply.summary: Telleo is a bald ring-wielder whose ship crashed on a foreign continent, where a ruthless inventor took him captive. Telleo carries a will that never breaks.

feats.scene: Slings a green spear of light through the hull of a pursuing aircraft.
Survives a crash landing inside a glowing cocoon.

reply.summary: Ralrn is a pink, yellow-eyed star-knight who once chased a fanatic across his own homeworld and hauled a ticking power source out of a city to spare the planet. Ralrn crushed his foe with a huge constructed weight.

feats.scene: Hammers a gigantic battery of light down on a hulking starship.
Emerges unharmed from a blast that could have scoured an entire world.

reply.summary: Vaiasor is a red-skinned, blue-eyed guardian with a family link to a famed rival, once a lantern bearer of green and later a keeper of white light. Vaiasor is considered one of his adopted world's finest heroes.

feats.scene: Shapes a titanic fist of light and slams a rogue planetoid off course.
Hovers unharmed in the heart of an orbital explosion.

reply.summary: Vamiasi is a ring-bearing space guardian who passes his glowing band to a worthy successor. Vamiasi conjures walls and beams from pure will, and flies unaided across the void.

feats.scene: Slashes a path of green energy across a pirate fleet.
Stops a hail of cannon fire with a hovering wall.

reply.summary: Inunu is a bald, black-eyed professional bodyguard, well paid and well drilled, assigned to protect a young prince. Inunu is competent with firearms and basic combat.

feats.scene: Draws a pistol and shoots a lock off a gate.
Takes a tackle to cover his charge and rolls upright.

reply.summary: Iuserrn is a street-gang overlord who ran a neighbourhood's crews and funded a youth centre as a front. Iuserrn was manipulated by a shapeshifter and died in a botched sit-down.

feats.scene: Fires a pistol twice into a crate to make a point.
Stands calmly in a smoke-filled meeting room.

reply.summary: Orestul is a bald, green-eyed infernal brute, one of three demon brothers, hungry for conquest. Orestul wields raw might and conjures flame to scorch his enemies.

feats.scene: Hurls a fireball that levels a stone watchtower.
Shakes off a wall of falling masonry.

reply.summary: Tiula is a pink, black-eyed demon, one of three brothers, summoned by a scheming sorcerer and yanked away by a pair of clowning magicians. Tiula is a dark, powerful presence wherever called.

feats.scene: Cracks open a hillside with a clenched fist.
Walks out of a crumbling circle of summoning stones.

reply.summary: Anuaun is a laid-off transit planner who built a gauntlet that drains motion from anything it touches, freezing victims in place for about an hour. Anuaun rides a hover cycle and once stilled most of a city.

feats.scene: Raises the gauntlet and halts every car, bird and pedestrian across a town centre.
Takes a hard fall off the hover cycle with only bruises.

reply.summary: Annalri is a bottom-tier costumed crook who tried out for a clown prince's sidekick slot. Annalri wears a suit covered in dots and hopes to be taken seriously.

feats.scene: Flings a handful of dots that pop with a feeble bang.
Falls from a ledge into a pile of trash bags.

reply.summary: Ninserreo is a crook in a suit covered in dots that detach into weapons and a getaway vehicle. Ninserreo captured a young sidekick once, later lost the gadgets, and got beaten for his troubles.

feats.scene: Swings a baseball bat into a patrolman's leg.
Is thrashed by an angry detective and survives with a neck brace.

reply.summary: Ritelirn is a young zealot trained in Europe by a monastic order who wore a sorrowful armoured suit. Ritelirn went mad within six weeks, believing every killing served heaven.

feats.scene: Cuts through a wooden door with one sweep of a burning blade.
Hits the pavement from a rooftop in his armour and stands.

reply.summary: Relicor is a failed lightning-struck sprinter who bound his soul to a serpent deity and became an adaptive living weapon. Relicor changes abilities on the fly and can raise destruction on the scale of a city.

feats.scene: Splits the ground beneath a downtown avenue and drops a skyscraper into the crack.
Reforms after being blown to ash by a missile salvo.
Blurs down a highway ahead of his own thunderclap.

reply.summary: Numntu is a tall, black-haired lawyer and statesman, skilled in rhetoric, law and rough wrestling holds. Numntu led a nation through a hard era and died violently.

feats.scene: Pins a heavyweight challenger to the mat at a county fair.
Walks all day on the campaign trail through mud and rain.
